Episode 244: Ambushing the Red Plutonian Tribe (4)
"Heh... Is this really a part of a public facility? Public facility, you say?"
Teekangung, Qwaol's laboratory.
Qwaol was examining the parts that Luna and Eltiot had stolen, turning them this way and that. Even to those unfamiliar with magic engineering, the craftsmanship was evidently outstanding.
A silver-metallic cube about the size of an apple, with a red core in the center that rotated unconnected to anything else.
"Is this thing so special? Enough for you to make such a fuss, Qwaol?"
Murakan asked, and Qwaol repeatedly nodded his head.

"Of course it is! Inside these thin metal lines, there are intricate and tiny technologies applied that humanity cannot even dream of. Those technologies form wavelengths, and the wavelengths transform into a core that rotates inside the part... It's so beautiful, it almost brings tears to my eyes."
"What? Nonsense. Hey, look, it's really crying. Jet! Hand over a handkerchief or something, it's giving me the creeps."
"Yes sir, here you go!"
"So, with this thing, we can mass-produce golden ships?"
Qwaol, wiping his face with a handkerchief, glared at Murakan.

"You brutish black dragon! Do you think I'm some sort of a god? I have to very carefully disassemble this part, which may never be found again, analyze it, understand the applied technologies. Even just getting to that point will take me at least half a year."
"Ignorant? Imbecile? This one really goes on and on. You're asking for a punch."
"Implementing the technology into our Teekangung is a separate issue. That will take at least a few years. At the very minimum."
"But half a year... And several times that to apply it? That's quite a long time. Don't you think, kid?"
Just as Jin was about to shrug his shoulders, loud, angry laughter erupted from outside the laboratory.
"Hahaha! Hahahaha! My disciple, I already feel like I've completely destroyed that Shimat fellow!"
"I got it, master. How many times are you going to say that?"
It was Eltiot and Luna, who had just left the treatment room.

The two had sustained significant injuries while escaping Bakle. Thanks to the abilities of the royal healers waiting in Teekangung and Luna's unique strong physique, they were able to get up from their sickbed so quickly.
Luna's visible wounds had healed, but some internal damage remained. Since she was swept away by madness and fell into a sort of trance, it was inevitable that there were lingering injuries.

“Hahaha, you must have seen it clearly too. Just before escaping from Chartin Prairie, I boldly revealed the component to their aerial fortress. Shimat must have seen that spectacle. He would have fallen, clutching the back of his neck.”
“Shimat didn't seem like someone who would get excited by just that.”

“You think you know Shimat better than me, my disciple? That guy always acts cool and full of dignity, but fundamentally, he has a childish side. Hahaha, falling for the bundle I purposely showed, he must be feeling just like when he used to trick me in ancient times. He must be so hot-headed now that he can't even sleep.”
“Yes, yes, that would be nice.”
Contrary to Luna's thoughts, Shimat was indeed furious. While he wasn't unable to sleep, he was grinding his teeth every time he recalled Eltiot's annoying face and actions at the last moment.
“Have you arrived, Lieutenant Eltiot, Lady Luna?”
“Oh yeah.”
“But Master, did you really know from the start that he wouldn't kill us but let us go?”
“Of course, I knew.”
“Then there was no need to flee so pathetically. Carrying you and running, I must have looked quite ridiculous.”

“My disciple, people's hearts are not one. Of course, he pretended to chase us and then let us go, just as I expected, but he could have changed his mind at any moment. Especially since he probably saw potential in you... He might have debated killing us right there several times. So fleeing hastily was the right thing to do.”
“Well, I did get swept up in madness and tried to finish him off.”

“That's different from Shimat's case. Shimat's choice involved only his will, while your choice involved madness influencing you. That's a good illustration of the current gap between you and Shimat.”
“A gap...”
“My disciple, if you can't suppress that madness, you will be destroyed.”
Suddenly, Eltiot said, erasing his smiling expression.
“...Yes, that seems certain.”
“It won't just be your destruction. This is a serious matter, so let's talk about it later during training.”
Eltiot stopped there and shifted his gaze to Qwaol, who was looking at him with sparkling, moist eyes.
“Eltiot... I don't understand. If the Red Plutonian tribe can really use this component in public facilities to such an extent, it seems we can never beat them.”
It was sincere.
He had told his colleagues that it would take half a year just to analyze it, but if something like this could be used in public facilities, the technological gap would be too vast.
Fortunately, however, Eltiot opened his eyes wide and retorted to Qwaol.
"Public facility? Who said it was a public facility?"
"You did. You said we were going to raid a public facility."
"Clang! When did I say that!"
"You certainly did, Master."
"Disciple, are you saying that even though I may have said that, I didn't mean it? How can you so casually expose your master's mistake? I'm disappointed."
"Yes. So, what is this part that the enemy tribe is using?"
All eyes focused on Eltiot.
"Aerial fortress Pivil."
"Ah, aerial fortress... what!?"
"What!?"
"I said it's Pivil. And it's a core component closely related to spatial leaps, one of Pivil's main functions."
Even Jin's eyes widened this time.

"Did you all take me, Eltiot, for a fool who would risk my precious life and the life of an ordinary disciple to steal some petty public facility? Of course not. While the disciple was buying time, I infiltrated Pivil."
Originally, Eltiot didn't expect to obtain the aerial fortress's part.

However, Luna had perfectly captured Shimat and the aerial fortress's attention, more than Eltiot had expected. Thanks to this, Eltiot gambled once more on infiltrating the aerial fortress, and it paid off.

"Disciple, do you now understand why I was so pleased, and why Shimat will be losing sleep tonight? Haha, you could say it's a surprise gift I prepared in my own way. Listen well, everyone, this part is... like the discovery of fire in this primitive Vamel alliance world."
"No, Master. How did you get into the aerial fortress? Was it a weapon that could be so easily penetrated?"
"It would normally be impossible. And it will remain impossible. The reason I could infiltrate this time is thanks to our seizing Pivil at the end of the Solar War."
As he said, Eltiot and the Blue Plutonian tribe had seized Pivil just before the great calamity started. At that time, they added Eltiot's authentication.
It was possible because the Enemy Heaven King had concealed his whereabouts as a god before becoming Shimat.
Eltiot explained this content carefully for a while.

"Now they will have discarded my authentication means, so it will not be easy to infiltrate again. Ha ha ha, sniff, sniff, what's this smell? Don't you smell something burning? Ah, it's the smell of Shimat regretting not killing my disciple and me."
In the end, Luna couldn't help but let out a stifled laugh at that moment. His lame joke was already becoming familiar.
"Then, Eltiot! Can you recognize the technology used in that part right away?"
Qwaul shouted in an excited voice.

"Analyzing 90% of it will be enough in ten days. Just look closely and recall. But the remaining 10% is almost in the realm of development, not analysis. The technology of the red guys was ahead of us from the start. That's your job, Qwaul."
Qwaul cast a truly unconfident look, something rare for him.

"The fact that I'm the greatest magical engineering genius of this age is self-evident. But as soon as I saw that thing, I was shocked, and at the same time, I despaired. I don't know if I can invent something better, or similar to it."

"A ripe rice stalk finally bows its head. Look here, Qwaul, you are just momentarily cowed by an overwhelming civilization. Your potential, that is, your ability to apply and understand science, would have been the best in my time as well. I will help you, so don't worry too much."
"......Are you serious?"
"Of course. I, Eltiot, always make an objective assessment. With your talent and my knowledge combined, we can flatten Shimat's nose again."
Jin met eyes with Eltiot.
"Then, Sir Eltiot. In your view, what can we achieve in the future using the parts of this Pivil?"
"Let's see. First, mass-producing the golden ship was our first goal, right?"
"That's correct."

"It's possible. Of course, the performance will be somewhat inferior due to mass production, but first, the fleet of the Vamel alliance will have the ability to make large-scale spatial leaps like the enemy."
"That's amazing."

"That's not all. We can also develop a space leap inhibition device. It means we can prevent the enemy fleet from suddenly appearing above the Tikan Palace. But the greatest reward we can gain from this device is something else."
"What is it?"
"The royal family of Lafrarosa. Our descendants, the Chumyung, your brothers. Once the analysis and development of the device are finished, we will be able to extract them."
Eltiot was well aware of Qwaul's research, especially the Lafrarosa liberation plan, from his bedside.
So he was sure. The moment they fully integrated Pivil's device into the alliance, they could bring them as a tribute.
It wasn't a highly limited summoning like the dark call, but permanent liberation.
"And once their power is added, we will be able to properly confront the red ones at their peak. Of course...... in the end, finishing off Shimat will be my disciple's job."
